Create a polished art-direction PREVIS for the original game TANKDRAFT. This is a tangible fully illustrated game screenshot pair, not a wireframe, marketing poster or asset sheet.
CORE GAME: a tank army draft AUTO-BATTLER, not a direct-control shooter. Small vehicles with large recognizable silhouettes. RIGHT ACTIVE BATTLE: top HUD player/opponent with exactly four heart positions for each side (filled and empty possible), "РАУНД 3" centered. Tall arena, camera high overhead at slight tilt, no horizon. Enemy army in upper half facing down, player army in lower half facing up. Approximately 24 visible small tanks, grouped in several readable ranks, heavy frontline at center engagement, long-barrel units and rocket/repair support behind. Blue identification accents for player, coral/red for enemy, distinct from role silhouettes. Show an actual ongoing clash: two compact muzzle flashes, few tracer shots, one lobbed artillery trail, small explosion, one pale repair pulse, restrained HP bars.
